invariants.name: paths_canvas_draws_path_meshes
invariants.note: The canvas's fills, strokes, clipped shapes and shadows reach the scene as tessellated meshes. Missing stays not-evaluable.

invariants.name: paths_canvas_still_reuses_every_mesh
invariants.note: Holds without a path_animation (and for scroll and scale): the recording did not change, so no mesh is tessellated again.

notes: Vector-path cost row (docs/reference/gpu.md §10). One 1200x720 custom-paint canvas: 96 cells of curved fills, round-capped and dashed curve strokes, miter-joined markers, even-odd rings, 12 shadows: 332 path ops, one mesh each, those of 32 cells under a circle path clip. Run with --path-animation scroll|scale|rerecord: scroll and scale move the list (no re-tessellation expected), rerecord redraws the canvas at a new zoom each frame (every mesh rebuilt; the rebuilt invariant does not apply). NanaUI-internal; no Iced/GPUI analog.
